path.description: Absolute path on the target daemon's file system of the text file to create or intentionally overwrite as a whole file, or a writable `vfs:/sessions/<sessionId>/...` path in the conversation directory. Relative paths are rejected; `vfs:/skills` and `vfs:/resources` are read-only. Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

content.description: Complete file content, written exactly as provided: line endings are not rewritten, and an existing file's encoding and BOM are preserved.
